crossRefs.note: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
“You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an…
I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an…
All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn…
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…
For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call…

translations.web: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
translations.bsb: Be assured that the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
translations.kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
translations.asv: Though hand join in hand, the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
